payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of word error rates (WER) between single-system and system combination approaches, demonstrating the performance of a single-system model against a baseline that includes system combination.

claims.text: The single-system model achieved a WER of 41.6% on DEV and 43.2% on EVAL, which is better than the previous best single-system results of 45.1% and 47.3% without system combination.
The proposed single-system model shows a 16% relative WER reduction on the DEV set compared to a system combination baseline, indicating its competitive performance.
